title: Siłownia · wszystko
note: Gym idiom (a1_case_gym / a2_case_gym2 / b1_aspect_gym / b1_virile_gym line): ZERO new material — teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both empty. Extends a2_case_gym2's seven-job case grid (Nom/Acc/Gen-sg/Loc/Inst/Nom-pl/Gen-pl) with the four systems B1 added since then: Dative with a noun (b1_dative_sg), Dative with a pronoun (b1_dative_pron), virile Nominative production (b1_virile_reco/b1_virile_nom), and virile past agreement (b1_virile_past) -- eleven jobs total, one noun (or pronoun) each. Title changed from tree.json's placeholder 'wszystkie przypadki' to 'wszystko' after check_new.py showed both 'wszystkie' and 'przypadki' are NEW -- neither is taught anywhere in the course, so the original label would have put an untaught Polish form in a title, the exact AGENTS.md violation already caught three times before (Z kim / pojazdem / Być fundament). 'wszystko' is taught (a2_smalltalk) and does the same job; tree.json's label field corrected to match when wiring this unit live. Every noun/pronoun/verb form used was checked individually against check_new.py / POOL before writing: brat family (brata/bratu/bratem, all taught, in three different cases -- accusative a1_miec, dative b1_dative_sg, instrumental a2_inst_z), kawa family (kawa/kawy/kawę/kaw, all taught, four different cases/numbers), bank/banku (nominative/locative-genitive dual duty, same trap a2_case_gym2's own intro already named), dom/domy/domów (singular/plural-nominative/plural-genitive), the fourteen virile nouns and dobrzy/nowe contrast pair from the virile block, and the six dative pronouns from b1_dative_pron. Confirmed NOT pool-legal and excluded: bracia/bracie (irregular plural of brat -- fenced, never even a distractor, same rule b1_virile_nom's own note set), kawą/kawie (instrumental/locative of kawa -- never taught, this course only ever inflects kawa through Nom/Acc/Gen), nauczyciela (accusative of nauczyciel -- never taught, only nauczycielem/nauczycielowi/nauczyciel/nauczycielka are), go/jemu (accusative-him and emphatic-dative-him pronouns -- neither taught, this course's pronoun grid stops at mu/ci/jej/nam/wam/im from b1_dative_pron). Bare governed prepositions (w, do, z, o) are never listed in uses_lemmas per SEQUENCING.md 6.3 -- their jobs are carried by the structure tags (prep_w_loc, prep_do_gen, prep_z_gen, o_loc), all already in uses_structures. HOMOGRAPH REVIEW, not re-teach: this gym deliberately does NOT re-run the ci/ci (virile demonstrative vs dative-pronoun) drill b1_dative_pron already did in full -- ci appears here only in its virile sense (ci studenci), consistent with how b1_virile_gym itself used it, and the second intro slide simply reminds the learner both meanings exist rather than drilling them side by side again, so as not to force a third collision test onto a unit that is meant to be zero-new review.

intro.title: Eleven jobs, one word
intro.body: Everything below is a noun, pronoun or verb form you already own, doing a job you already know. Nothing new here — just choosing the right form fast, now that all eleven jobs are mixed together, cases and virile agreement included.
intro.body_pl: Nic nowego — tylko szybki wybór właściwej formy, gdy wszystkie role są wymieszane.

intro.title: Same ending, different job — still on purpose
intro.title_pl: Ta sama końcówka, inna rola — wciąż celowo
intro.body:
banku still does two jobs, exactly like before: blisko banku is genitive, w banku is locative. That has not changed.

One more word does this too, further back than you might remember: ci. As a demonstrative it means 'these' and only appears before a virile plural noun — ci studenci. As a dative pronoun it means '[to/for] you' — Podoba ci się? Same four letters, two unrelated words. You already met both; this gym does not re-teach the split, just reminds you it exists so it does not trip you up mid-drill.
intro.body_pl: blisko banku (dopełniacz) i w banku (miejscownik). ci studenci (ci = these) i podoba ci się (ci = to you).

quiz.prompt: Mam ___. (my brother — the thing I have)
quiz.explain: mam takes an accusative object — brata, not the dative bratu you'd use after pomagam.
pomagać governs the dative, not the accusative — bratu, not brata.
jestem + instrumental for identity. nauczycielowi is dative (wrong job), nauczyciel is bare nominative, nauczycielka is the wrong gender word.
negation takes the genitive singular — kawy. kawę is accusative (for a positive mam), kaw is genitive plural (wrong number).
piję takes an accusative object, same job as mam — kawę, not the genitive kawy.
do + genitive = destination. w = where you already are, z = where you came from, o = what you're talking about.

quiz.prompt: ___ studenci są dobrzy. (these — a group with a man)
quiz.explain: studenci is virile — ci, not te.

quiz.prompt: ___ domy są nowe. (these — houses, not people)
quiz.explain: domy is never virile, however many there are — te.
ci already told you virile — the verb has to agree: -li.
kobiety is never virile — the verb takes -ły.
mu = him/it. mi = me, ci = you, jej = her — same dative family, different person.
jej = her. Same test as the last question, different person.
nie ma + genitive plural — domów. domy is the plain plural (for to są…), domu/dom are singular.

type_items.prompt_en: these students (a group with a man)

use_items.prompt_en: Type: I am at the bank.
